request:
镜头 s20：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：手持，昏暗，画面有压缩噪点。地下城的小公寓里，十六岁的宋念坐在床沿，抱着爸爸的笔记本，盯着墙上的屏幕。屏幕的蓝光在她脸上一闪一闪。环境声：屏幕里含混不清的新闻播报声、通风管道的嗡嗡声。
情绪：anxious, lonely, hushed
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, handheld with a slight unsteady drift
景深与虚实：Low-light noise and soft focus; her face and the notebook the only sharp area.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival-looking handheld frame inside a cramped underground apartment in 2058: 16-year-old Nian with a low ponytail and blunt bangs sits on the edge of the bunk in the blue glow of a small wall screen showing a news broadcast (abstract shapes only, no text), clutching her father's worn hardback notebook to her chest, waiting. Blocking lock: Nian sits on the bunk at frame left, the notebook against her chest; the glowing wall screen is at frame right; the round porthole window behind her.
Picture 2: Song's notebook with the crayon drawing taped on the first page (prop reference; role: prop reference). A worn hardback engineer's notebook lying open: on the first page the child's crayon drawing (a big black box with one red eye and many small smiling coloured boxes holding hands) is taped in with yellowed tape; around it and across the facing page, an adult's dense pencil diagrams of networks, many small circles linked by lines, arrows and loops spreading outward. Only abstract shapes, no legible words or numbers.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：indistinct news anchor voice from the wall screen, ventilation duct hum
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 9.0s, 24fps, archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium shot, shoulder-held ENG camera with one slight unsteady handheld drift from medium shot to a slightly tighter medium shot; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Nian sits on the edge of the bunk at frame left, the open notebook held against her chest, the small wall screen glowing cold blue at frame right, the round porthole window soft in the background behind her, the bunk edge and her bare feet low in the foreground. Start: she sits very still, shoulders drawn in, chin slightly down, the blue light pulsing across one side of her face and her hands while the rest of her stays in murky shadow. Middle: her thumb works slowly along the frayed cloth spine of the notebook, rubbing the worn corner, then her eyes lift from the page toward the screen at frame right and stay there, her lips slightly parted. The camera drifts a little closer and a little off level, losing the edge of the bunk. End: she exhales, pulls the notebook in harder so the boards press flat against her chest, and holds her gaze on the flickering screen, her face going still in the changing blue. Mood: anxious, lonely, hushed. Blur: her face and the notebook the only sharp area; the porthole window, the bulkhead and the bunk dissolving into soft low-light noise, the screen edge blooming into a hot clipped blue haze. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Indistinct news anchor voice from the wall screen, continuous ventilation duct hum, tape hiss under everything, the faint creak of the bunk frame, her slow breath, muffled pipe knocks and distant corridor voices; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
